mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods when FEDFUNDS declines, as measured by a t-test p-value > 0.05, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% over a 3-month window signals weakening labor market conditions, which triggers a shift in investor expectations toward future monetary policy accommodation, boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative or flat 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.0% for three consecutive months, or the signal fails to outperform a random baseline in walk-forward testing.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts below 2000 thousand units in two consecutive months signals a contraction in residential investment, which is a leading indicator of broader demand weakness and triggers a risk-off reaction in equities, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the signal exhibits Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production below 115.0 for two consecutive months indicates a weakening in real sector output, which signals a potential economic slowdown and leads to reduced corporate earnings expectations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the signal fails to achieve a Rank IC > 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential investment (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals a broad-based weakening in aggregate demand, which triggers a flight to safety and negative equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST < 2000 and RSAFS < 340000 in the same month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST < 2000 and RSAFS < 340000 occur, or the interaction signal fails to outperform a single-series baseline in walk-forward testing.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 3.5% combined with a CPI reading above 195.0 signals an active monetary tightening cycle amid persistent inflation, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction signal exhibits Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate above 5.0% and a decline in non-farm payrolls below 133000 thousand signals a labor market deterioration that increases recession risk, prompting equity investors to reduce exposure, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: labor market deterioration with job losses
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both conditions are met, or the interaction signal fails to achieve a Rank IC > 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption (RSAFS) below 340000 million dollars combined with a drop in GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1.0% annualized signals a weakening in aggregate demand, which leads to lower corporate earnings expectations and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction signal fails to achieve a Rank IC > 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
